scope: Focused R5-to-R6 runner/source binding review; no Cargo, Nextest, build, tests, or network execution by reviewer.

findings.source_delta: The frozen patch changes only crates/termrock-visibility-tests/tests/status.rs and adds _u64 to the three large GitHub run/check-suite ID literals. The numeric JSON values and assertions are preserved. The R6 independent source review binds the exact file, patch, R5 failure, and three diagnosed i32 literal-overflow errors.
findings.exact_selection: Runner argv selects only package termrock-visibility-tests and integration target status, with no filter and no --bin fixture. The pinned inventory has 53 unique status #[test] names, including the five required cases.
findings.fixture_role: The fixture binary is an explicit build dependency only: one source-declared unit test is recorded as unselected (selected count 0), while target/debug/fixture mode 0755 and debug/fixture.d source provenance are required. The event parser rejects a fixture suite or test event.
findings.preflight: The exact no-Cargo preflight binds runner/runplan/source/test/cache/checksum/request hashes, reports 53 expected selected cases, target selectors status only, fixture as build-only, an empty fresh target with no target artifacts, an absent output root, and cargo_spawned/nextest_spawned/tests_run/network_used all false.
findings.bounds: Runplan and runner agree on locked offline Nextest, 2 build jobs, 1 test thread, zero retries, 600-second timeout, 16 MiB combined output cap, 5-second TERM grace and 1-second post-KILL grace. The runner checks source/tool/cache inputs before and after, checks the target against the immediate preflight snapshot, and handles parent SIGINT/SIGTERM by terminating the detached process group and recording interruption.
findings.failure_history: The prior R5 result remains preserved: Cargo exit 101 before tests started (0/53 started), caused by the three large JSON integer literals. Earlier R1-R4 preflight/receipt limitations remain recorded in the R6 review request and were not erased.
findings.limits: This is static runner review plus inspection of the already-produced no-Cargo preflight only. No R6 Cargo/Nextest execution or test pass is established. Test success would validate source status rendering only; it does not qualify product readiness, execution, evidence admission, or publication.
